name: Small slime
appearance: A small blue slime.
behavior: Wanders between attacks, then winds up a strike at an adjacent tile.
response: Leave the marked tile before the strike. Use its pause afterward to attack or pass.

name: Orange slime
appearance: A larger orange slime.
behavior: Wanders and attacks an adjacent tile with a shorter wind-up than the small blue slime.
response: Move off its target tile as soon as the attack cue appears.
warning: Do not use the small slime's slower rhythm as your timing guide.

name: Bat
appearance: A dark gray bat with spreading wings.
behavior: Wanders, then telegraphs a dash when you line up along its row or column.
response: Step sideways out of the dash line before it launches.
warning: Stepping toward it onto its intended landing tile can still get you hit.

name: Club skeleton
appearance: A bare-headed skeleton carrying a wooden club.
behavior: Approaches when you come near, then winds up a strike at the adjacent tile it targeted.
response: Draw out the swing, leave its marked tile, then attack during the pause.

name: Whip plant
appearance: A rooted green plant with a curled vine.
behavior: Stays in place and lashes along one marked direction, reaching up to two tiles.
response: Step off the marked line. A wall or solid obstacle between you and the plant also blocks the lash.
warning: It can hit beyond melee distance.

name: Blue frog
appearance: A small blue frog with large yellow eyes.
behavior: Hops back and forth between nearby tiles. Landing on you deals damage and makes it bounce back. Egg clusters also produce these frogs.
response: Watch the marked landing tile and keep it clear while the frog is winding up.
warning: A blocked hop can change its route. On floors 7–9, these frogs come from egg clusters.

name: Frog egg cluster
appearance: A stationary purple cluster of round eggs.
behavior: Produces blue frogs nearby. A shield protects the cluster while any frog it produced is still alive.
response: Clear its spawned frogs to remove the shield, then attack the exposed cluster.
warning: Attacking the shielded cluster will not damage it.

name: Large whip plant
appearance: A larger green vine creature with purple growths.
behavior: Holds its ground and lashes along one marked direction, reaching up to three tiles.
response: Leave the marked row or column instead of retreating just one tile along it.
warning: Its lash reaches farther than the smaller whip plant's.

name: Skeleton archer
appearance: A skeleton with a bow and red-feathered arrows.
behavior: Fires arrows along its row or column. It retreats when you approach and can line up another shot while backing away.
response: Cross out of the firing line or use walls and solid obstacles as cover. Approach from the side.
warning: A retreating archer can still prepare a shot.

name: Armored skeleton
appearance: A helmeted skeleton carrying a bright blade.
behavior: Chases nearby players, then strikes all four tiles directly beside it at once.
response: Move beyond the four adjacent tiles before the attack lands; a diagonal position is outside this strike.
warning: Circling to another directly adjacent side does not dodge the attack.

name: Exploding mushroom
appearance: A small purple mushroom with a lit fuse.
behavior: Arms when you approach, follows you while its fuse burns, then stops and explodes. Lobbing mushrooms can throw more of them nearby.
response: Use its final stationary warning to leave the whole marked blast area.
warning: The blast hits diagonal neighbors too: all eight surrounding tiles are dangerous.

name: Party-hat ghost
appearance: A pale mint ghost wearing a pink party hat.
behavior: Follows slowly and blocks tiles without attacking. After lingering beside you, it panics and retreats before returning.
response: Route around it and use its retreat to get through crowded passages.

name: Hat-wearing frog
appearance: A pink frog wearing a broad straw hat.
behavior: Wanders until you approach, then prepares short hops toward you. It chooses a new destination for each hop.
response: Stay off the marked landing tile. Recheck each new cue as it moves closer.
warning: Unlike the blue frog, it does not keep a fixed back-and-forth route.

name: Pale ghost
appearance: A pale cyan ghost with yellow eyes and no hat.
behavior: Follows slowly and winds up adjacent strikes. After repeated strikes, it briefly panics and flees.
response: Leave its marked attack tile and keep a route open around it.
warning: It cannot be killed and, unlike the party-hat ghost, can hurt you.

name: Flame orb
appearance: A floating orange fireball with a dark face.
behavior: Telegraphs a straight dash when you line up along its row or column. It can begin its dash from farther away than a bat.
response: Move sideways out of the marked line instead of toward its landing tile.
warning: Distance alone does not make an open row or column safe.

name: Orange imp
appearance: An orange creature with a dark crest and pointed head.
behavior: Pursues you from a distance, then winds up a strike at a single adjacent tile.
response: Move off its target tile during the wind-up, then use its recovery to attack.

name: Dark imp
appearance: A charcoal-colored creature with glowing eyes and an orange crack across its head.
behavior: Pursues you from a distance and attacks all four tiles directly beside it at once.
response: Leave its adjacent cross before it strikes. Move to a diagonal tile or farther away.
warning: Moving to another directly adjacent side still leaves you in its attack.

name: Lobbing mushroom
appearance: A large purple mushroom with pink spots and a smoking top.
behavior: Stays in place and repeatedly throws small exploding mushrooms onto open tiles near you.
response: Watch where each mushroom lands, move clear of its blast, and defeat the thrower to stop further throws.
warning: Its thrown mushrooms are separate enemies with their own fuses.

name: Hooded ghost
appearance: A dark blue hooded ghost with yellow eyes.
behavior: Follows more slowly than the pale ghost but lands heavier adjacent strikes. It briefly flees after repeated strikes.
response: Keep moving off its marked attack tile and pass when its retreat opens a path.
warning: It cannot be killed. Its slower movement does not mean a longer attack warning.

name: Chest mimic
appearance: A chest that reveals teeth and a long tongue.
behavior: Hides as a chest on normal floors. Revealing it triggers an immediate adjacent ambush; afterward it chases and uses telegraphed melee strikes.
response: Keep enough energy to survive a surprise when opening chests. After the reveal, dodge its marked tile and attack during its recovery.
warning: The opening ambush does not give the usual wind-up warning.

name: Pot mimic
appearance: A purple pot with a jagged mouth after it is revealed.
behavior: Hides as a pot on normal floors and ambushes an adjacent player immediately when revealed. It then chases with a shorter melee wind-up than the chest mimic.
response: Expect a possible surprise when breaking pots, then move promptly when its next attack cue appears.
warning: The reveal can hit before you get a turn to dodge.

name: Sir Jackalot
appearance: A towering armored boss carrying a long spear.
behavior: Lines up broad spear thrusts and advances as he strikes. At half health, he leaps and prepares a ring-shaped shockwave; afterward his thrusts come faster and hit harder.
response: Leave the entire marked spear band, then clear the shockwave ring after his leap. Reassess your escape route before every attack.
warning: He does not take the ordinary enemies' recovery pause after a thrust.
